eventClusters.statement: The March 21 Xiangshui explosion removed a meaningful supplier of dye intermediates and triggered immediate m-phenylenediamine/dye repricing, creating a potentially finite but measurable earnings windfall for unaffected integrated leaders.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The price shock is real but may be transient and was immediately traded. Deep research must verify which listed companies are operationally unaffected, have direct sellable capacity, and retain expectation room after the first rerating.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can an unaffected integrated producer show a quantifiable price-to-earnings bridge before normalization, making this a valid V1.5 base-horizon convexity case?

eventClusters.statement: Rapid recovery in A-share turnover and self-trading conditions had already converted into strong January-February broker profits, but the brokerage sector itself had sharply rerated by late March.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Realized monthly earnings are strong, but stock-price absorption is also extreme and market activity can normalize quickly. Deep research must distinguish a genuine residual earnings gap from chasing the rally.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did any liquid A-share broker retain enough expectation/valuation room for base-horizon selection after the sector's YTD rerating?

eventClusters.statement: Jan-Feb excavator sales accelerated nearly 40% YoY, while the leading OEM entered 2019 with very strong profit growth and share gains, indicating continued machinery earnings momentum.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: 2018 was already a boom year, so strong absolute growth may be well anticipated. Deep research must measure late-cycle/expectation burden rather than extrapolate unit growth mechanically.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which machinery expressions still had revision room and acceptable downside at March 31 despite the already-visible boom?

eventClusters.statement: MSCI formally committed to raising A-share inclusion from 5% to 20% across 2019, creating scheduled foreign-flow demand but with diffuse company-level earnings transmission.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Index flows can move prices without improving company earnings. Do not treat broad inclusion as a fundamental company-engine signal unless a direct monetization path exists.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there any direct listed expression with measurable earnings conversion, or should this remain a broad flow event without stock selection?

eventClusters.statement: The government locked in a manufacturing VAT cut from 16% to 13% effective April 1, lowering tax burden broadly but with highly heterogeneous pass-through to prices, customers and margins.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: VAT cuts may be passed through to customers rather than retained as margin, so broad thematic mapping is unsafe without company-specific pricing power and tax-base evidence.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does any coherent company/industry subset have a direct, under-reflected earnings bridge, or is the event too broad for selection?

eventClusters.statement: African-swine-fever concerns existed, but the latest cutoff-valid NBS data still showed pork prices down 4.8% YoY, so the later scarcity regime was not yet confirmed by the observable physical price signal.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Future 2019 scarcity must not leak backward into Q1. Deep research should fail closed unless company-level sales prices/costs already show a measurable turn before March 31.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there enough pre-cutoff producer-specific evidence to override the still-weak official pork-price signal?

normalizedClaims: Published pre-event baseline forecast 2019 net profit RMB4.593bn and EPS RMB1.412. At the report price the 2019E PE was 7.5x; this forecast is used only as a stale-but-auditable earnings baseline, not as a current valuation quote.

evidenceDocuments.title: 间苯二胺出现供给缺口，浙江龙盛四天三涨停
normalizedClaims: Company disclosure said the Xiangshui accident affected roughly 25% of m-phenylenediamine market capacity.
Market m-phenylenediamine price rose from roughly RMB45-50k/t before the accident to about RMB100k/t by March 27.
Contemporaneous analyst sensitivity estimated that if Longsheng produced 50kt in Q2-Q4, each RMB10k/t price increase could add roughly RMB500m gross profit and RMB300m net profit.
On March 28 the article observed Longsheng at about RMB16.47 after three limit-up days in four sessions.
